tips.text: Welcome to Stem Studio. Drop a song in step one to split it, or import stems you already have.
Pick the stems you want, then press Split. Everything runs on your own computer, and nothing is uploaded.
Each stem gets its own lane. Use M to mute it, S to solo it, and the slider to set its level.
Click a stem to open its effects. Start from a preset, then switch modules on and off to hear the difference.
Press A B to bypass every effect at once, so you can compare before and after at the same loudness.
The Clean tab scans a stem for separation artifacts and repairs them without touching the original.
The Drums tab breaks the drum stem into kick, snare, toms, hi hat and cymbals.
The Vocals tab splits the lead singer from the backing vocals.
Measure the mix to see its loudness and true peak before you export.
When it sounds right, press Render and export to save every stem and the mix.
Voice commands are off until you switch them on. Hold the mic button, say a command, then let go.
Try: drop the bass, mute vocals, solo drums, unsolo, play, stop, or export.
